import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from datetime import datetime

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'date': ['2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01'],
    'time': ['00:00', '02:00', '04:00', '06:00', '08:00'],
    'product': ['Cappuccino', 'Cappuccino', 'Tea', 'Latte', 'Americano'],
    'size': ['Large', 'Medium', 'Small', 'Large', 'Medium'],
    'price': [4.18, 4.01, 5.22, 6.37, 7.07],
    'quantity': [2, 3, 1, 2, 3],
    'payment_method': ['Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Cash'],
    'customer_age_group': ['55+', '35-44', '18-24', '45-54', '45-54'],
    'is_takeaway': [1, 1, 1, 1, 1],
    'total': [8.36, 12.03, 5.22, 12.74, 21.21]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Create datetime column for time series analysis
df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'] + ' ' + df['time'])

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Time series of total sales
axes[0, 0].plot(df['datetime'], df['total'], marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Total Sales Over Time', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Time', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Total Amount ($)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
axes[0, 0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Product sales by total amount
product_totals = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
axes[0, 1].bar(product_totals.index, product_totals.values, color=sns.color_palette("husl", len(product_totals)))
axes[0, 1].set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Total Amount ($)', fontsize=12)
for i, v in enumerate(product_totals.values):
    axes[0, 1].text(i, v + 0.5, f'${v:.2f}', ha='center', fontsize=10)

# 3. Sales by size
size_totals = df.groupby('size')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
axes[0, 2].bar(size_totals.index, size_totals.values, color=sns.color_palette("Set2", len(size_totals)))
axes[0, 2].set_title('Total Sales by Size', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Total Amount ($)', fontsize=12)
for i, v in enumerate(size_totals.values):
    axes[0, 2].text(i, v + 0.5, f'${v:.2f}', ha='center', fontsize=10)

# 4. Sales by age group
age_totals = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
axes[1, 0].bar(age_totals.index, age_totals.values, color=sns.color_palette("viridis", len(age_totals)))
axes[1, 0].set_title('Total Sales by Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Total Amount ($)', fontsize=12)
for i, v in enumerate(age_totals.values):
    axes[1, 0].text(i, v + 0.5, f'${v:.2f}', ha='center', fontsize=10)

# 5. Payment method distribution
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
axes[1, 1].pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
               colors=sns.color_palette("pastel", len(payment_counts)), startangle=90)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Quantity vs Price scatter plot
scatter = axes[1, 2].scatter(df['price'], df['quantity'], c=df['total'], s=200, 
                             cmap='YlOrRd', alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
axes[1, 2].set_title('Price vs Quantity (colored by Total)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 2].set_xlabel('Price ($)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Quantity', fontsize=12)

# Add product labels to scatter points
for i, row in df.iterrows():
    axes[1, 2].annotate(row['product'], (row['price'], row['quantity']), 
                       xytext=(5, 5), textcoords='offset points', fontsize=9)

# Add colorbar for scatter plot
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=axes[1, 2])
cbar.set_label('Total Amount ($)', fontsize=12)

# Adjust layout
plt.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis - January 1, 2024', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
